system.description:
You extend your chakra throughout the earth around you extending up to 30 feet from you. For the duration you gain tremor sense. Creatures who move under the surface that you are standing on are perceived by you with your tremor sense.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If cast at C-Rank Increase the duration to 1 hour. If cast at B-Rank; 8 Hours. If cast at A-Rank 24 Hours.
